reason: In common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/crypto/CryptoIntegration.java:55-73, detectProvider() sorts loaded providers by order() descending, logs extras at debug level, and returns foundProviders.get(0) without throwing on multiple providers or equal-order ties. DefaultCryptoProvider (crypto/default/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/def/DefaultCryptoProvider.java:82-85), WildFlyElytronProvider (crypto/elytron/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/elytron/WildFlyElytronProvider.java:75-78), and FIPS1402Provider (crypto/fips1402/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/fips/FIPS1402Provider.java:113-116) all return 200, so ties fall back to ServiceLoader/classpath order and auto-detecting deployments with a stray crypto-default jar can silently select non-FIPS BouncyCastle.
